explanation: Anna Magnani had won Best Actress earlier, for The Rose Tattoo (1955), but that role was in English. Two Women was directed by Vittorio De Sica.

claims.text: Sophia Loren won the Academy Award for Best Actress for Two Women (1960), the first acting Oscar for a performance in a language other than English.
Anna Magnani, Gina Lollobrigida and Claudia Cardinale did not win an Oscar for Two Women.
Anna Magnani won the Academy Award for Best Actress for The Rose Tattoo (1955), an English-language film.
Vittorio De Sica directed Two Women (La ciociara).
